correctness.rationale: On the affine chart y=0 at a root xi of the quartic difference b=phi1-phi2, distinct branch loci force phi1(xi)=phi2(xi)≠0, so the quadratic coefficient in y is a unit and completed-square/Morse reduction gives V²+unit*b(xi+u)², the A_{2m-1} germ for root multiplicity m. At P∞ on chart Y=1, homogenization yields a unique quadratic s² with critical section s=O(r³) and residual −4r⁴+O(r⁶), so A3 in every stratum (allowed char is not 2). At Q∞ on chart X=1 when d1=0 the v² coefficient is -4 and transverse critical section v=0; D(1,s)=d2*s−d3*s²+d4*s³ yields A1, A3, A5 for leading order 1,2,3. These give I-1/II-1 3A1+A3, I-2/II-2/II-3 A1+2A3, and I-3/II-4 A3+A5, all delta=5 matching sextic genus defect. Independently checked leading coefficients, orders and all seven basket sums exactly using symbolic arithmetic. Formal coordinate reductions, not the finite symbolic check alone, prove the uniform assertion.
